title: Container kinds
description: How a container of a view document arranges its children. A screen is built from containers, mixed freely, so one screen can hold a process graphic with fixed positions beside a form that reflows (owner, 2026-11-20, FB-176). Adding a kind is one approved change to this list and never changes a saved screen.

entries.description: Every child sits at an exact position and size; the whole container scales to fit or keeps its size. For a process graphic.
Children are arranged in a row or a column that wraps and stacks as the display narrows. For forms, tables and dashboards.
Shows one of its children, chosen by the width of the display. For a screen that must be arranged differently on a phone.

change_history.reason: the list declares the format it is written in (spec_version, the governed-list schema 0.1.0; FB-234); its entries are unchanged
